summary: This experimental memo defines BinaryTime, a new ASN.1 type that represents date and time as a number. It also defines a binary-signing-time attribute for CMS as an alternative to the signing-time attribute. It was replaced by RFC 6019.

eli5.summary: Instead of writing a date in words, this writes it as a plain number that computers can compare easily. It was later replaced by RFC 6019.

questions: binary signing time attribute in cms
